stories.title: Trump warns Iran will be 'totally wiped out' as US strikes IRGC and port targets
stories.reason: Fresh US strikes hit Iranian targets near Asaluyeh and Lavan Island and explosions were reported in Dubai as residents sheltered, marking the sharpest escalation yet in the six-month war.

stories.title: Death toll from Nepal-China floods surpasses 1,000 as nearly 4,000 remain missing
stories.reason: Rescue teams have pulled nearly 12,000 survivors since last Wednesday, but the UN warns the toll will likely keep climbing as crews reach communities still cut off a week after the flood.

stories.title: US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll resigns after clashes with Hegseth over fired generals
stories.reason: The youngest-ever Army secretary quit after the Defense Secretary purged generals tied to his modernization push, exposing a deepening rift atop the Pentagon during an active war footing.

stories.title: Stocks slide and oil jumps nearly 4% as US-Iran conflict escalates further
stories.reason: The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all fell as rising bond yields and oil above $89 a barrel revived inflation worries just weeks before the Fed's next rate decision.

stories.title: Pentagon adds ChatGPT and Grok to its GenAI.mil platform; Claude notably absent
stories.reason: More than 3 million military and civilian personnel now get OpenAI and xAI tools alongside Gemini, while Anthropic remains locked out over its refusal to loosen surveillance and weapons-use guardrails.

stories.title: Amazon, Microsoft, Alphabet and Meta on pace for $725 billion in 2026 AI capex
stories.reason: The combined figure, up 77% year over year and larger than Switzerland's GDP, is the biggest single-year corporate infrastructure buildout in history, almost entirely aimed at AI data centers and chips.

stories.title: Russian missile and drone barrage kills at least 12 in Kyiv, including six railway workers
stories.reason: A ballistic missile strike hit a railway depot on a sixth straight night of attacks on the capital, underscoring that Russia's war grinds on even as global attention is consumed by the Iran conflict.

stories.title: USPS whistleblower says rushed mail-voting verification system could disrupt the midterms
stories.reason: The claim adds a new flashpoint to the fight over Trump's mail-voting executive order just as the Supreme Court has let parts of it move forward ahead of November.
